title: The Things We Choose to Build
author: rithythul
publicationNote: Working title · Publication date to come
summary: My journey of learning while building startups, and the lessons from the experiments and the mentors along the way.
homeNote: Some of those mentors never knew they were teaching me.
description: The book follows my journey: what I remember, how I set out to learn, and how I built startups while still learning how.
It collects the lessons from those experiments, and from the people I count as mentors, whether they know it or not.
